resources.string:
Da izvedete određene stavke (poput zaključavanja zaslona) dok izvodite gestu, CyberHome-u je potreban pristup postavki za pristupačnost.

CyberHome ne prati korisničke radnje, iako je odobrenje za to potrebno za sve usluge pristupačnosti. CyberHome odbija svaki događaj poslan od sustava.

Da zaključate zaslon, ili da otvorite Nedavno, CyberHome koristi pristupačnu uslugu preformGlobalAction.
Za pristup prečacima i dodatnim značajkama, postavite CyberHome kao zadani pokretač
At a Glance can be manually added to the home screen by placing the CyberHome widget
You are about to update from CyberHome %1$s to CyberHome %2$s, please consider carefully as newer major version may be unstable than current version.
To put the device to sleep, set CyberHome as a device admin app. Tap \"Open settings\", then tap \"Activate this device admin app.\"
To %1$s, turn on the CyberHome accessibility service. Tap \"Open settings\", select \"CyberHome\" and turn on \"Use CyberHome.\"

CyberHome uses Accessibility\'s `performGlobalAction` method to perform this action. This is a sensitive permission that allows monitoring other apps. However, CyberHome is not configured for that functionality and receives no events.
These settings will be ignored as CyberHome isn\'t set as the Recents screen provider
